tour.help_tour: Take the tour of this page
tour.help_tour_none: No tour for this page yet
tour.welcome_body: This is where production chains get worked out — from a single recipe to supplying an entire settlement.
tour.welcome_recipes_b: A catalogue of every building in the game. Assemble your own complex from them in the graph editor.
tour.welcome_community_b: Finished complexes from other players: open them, learn from them, copy them to yourself.
tour.welcome_needs_b: How much food, goods, farmland and buildings a settlement of a given size needs.
tour.browse_nav_b:
“Recipes” is the building catalogue and your own complexes.
“Community” is what other players built.
“Settlement” works out what the population needs.
tour.browse_search_b: out:steel — what produces it, in:coal — what consumes it, name:furnace — by building name. Combine them: & for and, | for or, brackets to group. The full cheat sheet lives under the “?” button.
tour.browse_filters_b: Show recipes only, complexes only, or everything. “Hidden” brings back what you removed from the listing.
tour.browse_row_b: Click to unfold it: inputs and outputs per minute, workers, power. Clicking the name searches for everything tied to that building.
tour.browse_newcx_b: Opens the editor to build a complex. A complex is a chain of recipes that produces a particular resource.
tour.browse_select_b: Tick a few rows and a bar appears at the bottom: hide clutter from the catalogue, bring it back, delete your own complexes.
tour.browse_help_b: The “?” button in the header replays this tour any time and holds the search cheat sheet.
tour.cheat_plain: a bare word searches every field
tour.needs_params_b: Population, farm, fertilizer and building tiers — the whole page is recalculated from them. Wood and rations are set here too.
tour.needs_section_b: Every section folds with the button on the left and can be dragged by its header. The order and folded state are remembered for next time.
tour.needs_fields_b: How many fields to build and what to rotate on them. “×2” means the crop takes two of the four plots; the number beside it is its share.
tour.needs_cover_b: Fields come whole, so the actual yield is almost always a little above demand. That difference is the surplus.
tour.needs_recycle_b: Leftovers go to gas, biomass and compost. This shows how many digesters and mixers that takes.
tour.needs_fork_b: Where the game offers a choice — what to make oil, feed or snacks from — you can tick several recipes. The order follows land cost: the pricier ones pick up surplus, the cheapest is grown to cover the rest.
tour.needs_outputs_b: What the settlement consumes and what is left over — already net of everything spent internally.
tour.editor_canvas_b: Drag nodes with the mouse. Ctrl+click selects several, Shift+drag selects a rectangle.
tour.editor_node_b: A building with a recipe: inputs on the left, outputs on the right, numbers per minute including the multiplier.
tour.editor_port_b: The colour is the state: blue is balanced, orange is missing a producer, green is an external port, purple runs to demand. Clicking opens the list of who produces or consumes that resource.
tour.editor_lcm_b: Clicking a link turns on multiple matching: neighbouring buildings are scaled so the resource divides evenly.
tour.editor_summary_b: Workers, power, computing and build cost, then what the complex asks for from outside and what it hands out.
tour.editor_save_b: Save and stay, or save and leave. Next to it is visibility: a public complex shows up in the Community section.
tour.editor_fork_b: Someone else's complex opens read-only. The copy lands in your own complexes and can be edited.
